chief_complaint: Management of advanced chronic kidney disease (stage 4) with hypertension, hyperlipidemia, and preparation for kidney transplantation
history_of_present_illness: 54-year-old male with progressive CKD stage 4 documented since 1981, secondary to longstanding type 2 diabetes mellitus manifested by proteinuria and microalbuminuria. He has essential hypertension treated with lisinopril and amlodipine, hyperlipidemia on simvastatin, obesity (BMI ≥30), and daily tobacco use. Recent vitals show BP 97/64 mmHg, HR 94 bpm. He reports chronic knee osteoarthritis pain managed with naproxen and acetaminophen/oxycodone. Socially, he is employed full‑time, lacks reliable transportation, experiences chronic stress, and is a veteran. He is awaiting kidney transplantation.
